_comment: The App-master bench baseline — the sweep result a change must not regress below. Until this file existed, the sweep verdict lived in a COMMIT BODY ('R2 green 6/6, sweep #23'): the next agent could only learn it by reading git log, and nothing could fail when it went backwards. `npm run bench:gate` reads the newest run per scenario out of bench/app-master/runs/, compares it here, writes bench/app-master/gate.json, and exits non-zero on a regression. `requiredExpectations` names the checks that must still be MEASURED — an expectation quietly dropped from a scenario file is a coverage regression that a pass/fail count cannot see (unmeasured is not zero). Update this file in the SAME change that legitimately moves a number, and say which number moved and why.
